note: Third-party assets of the animated film 'Wish You Were Here' that are not kept in git: motion clips and four background characters from the Microsoft Rocketbox avatar library. scripts/demo/wish_fetch.py downloads them into .asset-cache/rocketbox-film (and records sizes and hashes in docs/cinematic/asset-provenance.json); scripts/demo/wish_cast.py converts the textures and places everything in the Unity project's film-only folder (native/quest/Assets/SameSky/Editor/Film/Cast, git-ignored, editor-only: nothing of it goes into a build of the app).
